title: Trade Tensions and Map Changes: The US-Canada Conflict Grows
subtitle: As trade wars escalate, major tech companies update maps to reflect controversial name changes.

summary.en: The trade relationship between the United States and Canada has worsened significantly. Both nations are preparing to apply heavy taxes on each other's goods. Meanwhile, major technology companies have updated their digital maps to follow a recent US government order. President Trump ordered the renaming of Lake Ontario to Lake America. Canadian leaders have criticized the move and the current state of trade negotiations.
summary.zh: 美國與加拿大的貿易關係顯著惡化。兩國正準備對彼此的商品課徵高額稅款。與此同時，大型科技公司已更新其數位地圖以配合美國政府近期的命令。川普總統下令將安大略湖更名為美國湖。加拿大領導人對此舉以及當前的貿易談判狀態表示批評。

paragraphs.en: The economic relationship between the United States and Canada has reached a difficult point. Following the collapse of trade talks, both nations are now preparing to apply heavy tariffs—taxes on imported goods—to each other's products. According to The Guardian World, these new measures are set to begin on September 8 and will affect $20 billion worth of goods for each country. This move is expected to put significant pressure on residents in both nations as the cost of daily items may rise.
paragraphs.zh: 美國與加拿大的經濟關係已陷入僵局。隨著貿易談判破裂，兩國目前正準備對彼此的產品課徵高額關稅，也就是針對進口商品加徵稅款。根據《衛報》國際版報導，這些新措施預計於九月八日生效，雙方各有價值兩百億美元的商品將受到影響。此舉預計將對兩國居民造成巨大壓力，因為日常用品的價格可能會隨之上漲。

paragraphs.en: Amid this growing conflict, a strange dispute over geography has also emerged. President Donald Trump recently signed an executive order to rename Lake Ontario as “Lake America.” While Canadian officials have strongly rejected this change, major technology companies are beginning to follow the order. As reported by The Verge, Apple Maps has now officially updated its service to label the body of water as “Lake America,” following a similar move by Google. The Verge noted that while the name change appears on international versions of these apps, the Canadian version of Apple Maps still displays the traditional name, “Lake Ontario.”
paragraphs.zh: 在這場日益激烈的衝突中，一場關於地理名稱的奇特爭議也隨之浮現。美國總統川普（Donald Trump）近期簽署了一項行政命令，將安大略湖（Lake Ontario）更名為「美國湖」（Lake America）。儘管加拿大官員強烈反對這項變更，大型科技公司卻開始配合該命令。據《邊緣》（The Verge）報導，蘋果地圖（Apple Maps）現已正式更新其服務，將該水域標示為「美國湖」，Google 也採取了類似行動。《邊緣》指出，雖然這些應用程式的國際版本出現了名稱變更，但加拿大版的蘋果地圖仍顯示傳統名稱「安大略湖」。

paragraphs.en: This digital change is not the first time such an order has been issued. The Verge reported that both Apple and Google previously changed the name of the Gulf of Mexico to the “Gulf of America” after a similar executive order from President Trump last year. Interestingly, the mapping service MapQuest has chosen not to follow these changes, which has reportedly helped it become one of the most popular apps on the Apple App Store.
paragraphs.zh: 這種數位地圖上的變更並非首次發生。據《邊緣》報導，去年在川普發布類似的行政命令後，蘋果與 Google 也曾將墨西哥灣（Gulf of Mexico）改名為「美國灣」（Gulf of America）。有趣的是，地圖服務商 MapQuest 選擇不跟進這些變更，據報導，這使其成為蘋果應用程式商店中最受歡迎的應用程式之一。

paragraphs.en: The trade conflict itself remains the most serious part of the tension. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney has publicly criticized the US administration, urging officials in Washington to “start being serious” about trade discussions. According to The Guardian World, Carney stated that the current behavior of US officials is not helpful for solving the economic problems between the two neighbors. He specifically mentioned that recent trade talks failed because of disagreements over how to handle the discussions and issues regarding language rights in Quebec.
paragraphs.zh: 貿易衝突本身仍是緊張局勢中最嚴峻的部分。加拿大總理卡尼（Mark Carney）公開批評美國政府，敦促華府官員在貿易討論上「開始認真看待」。根據《衛報》國際版報導，卡尼表示，美國官員目前的行為無助於解決兩國鄰邦之間的經濟問題。他特別提到，近期的貿易談判之所以失敗，是因為雙方對於如何進行討論以及魁北克省的語言權利議題存在分歧。

paragraphs.en: On the American side, officials have expressed frustration with the current situation. The US trade representative, Jamieson Greer, suggested that Canada has not been clear about its desire to reach a deal. Greer told The Guardian World that the breakdown in talks was caused by unreasonable requests from the Canadian side, such as demands for lower taxes on heavy-duty trucks. He argued that the US is currently not in any active trade negotiations with Canada, leaving the future of the economic relationship uncertain.
paragraphs.zh: 在美國方面，官員們對當前局勢表示挫折。美國貿易代表葛瑞爾（Jamieson Greer）指出，加拿大對於達成協議的意願並不明確。葛瑞爾告訴《衛報》國際版，談判破裂是由於加方提出了不合理的要求，例如要求降低重型卡車的稅率。他主張美國目前並未與加拿大進行任何積極的貿易談判，這使得兩國經濟關係的未來充滿不確定性。

paragraphs.en: President Trump has also been vocal about his position, claiming that Canada has unfairly charged American farmers high tariffs for many years. He has suggested that Canada wants the benefits of being a US state without actually joining the country. As the two nations prepare for the upcoming wave of tariffs, the atmosphere remains tense. With no new negotiations currently planned, it is unclear how long this trade war will last or how it will affect the daily lives of people living on both sides of the border.
paragraphs.zh: 川普總統也公開表達立場，聲稱加拿大多年來對美國農民課徵不公平的高額關稅。他暗示加拿大既想享有美國各州的好處，卻又不願真正加入美國。隨著兩國為即將到來的關稅浪潮做準備，氣氛依然緊張。由於目前沒有新的談判計畫，這場貿易戰將持續多久，以及將如何影響邊境兩側民眾的日常生活，目前仍不明朗。

keyTerms.definitionEn: An action or step taken to achieve a specific goal.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（移動），這裡作名詞用。文中：This move is expected to put significant pressure on residents in both nations as the cost of daily items may rise.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Expressing opinions or feelings freely and loudly.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 直言不諱的、大聲表達意見的。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見與聲音有關，這裡指公開表達立場。文中：President Trump has also been vocal about his position, claiming that Canada has unfairly charged American farmers high tariffs for many years.

keyTerms.definitionEn: The failure of a relationship or a process.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞片語 break down（故障），這裡作名詞用。文中：Greer told The Guardian World that the breakdown in talks was caused by unreasonable requests from the Canadian side, such as demands for lower taxes on heavy-duty trucks.

quiz.question: According to the article, what is the current status of the digital mapping of 'Lake America'?

options.A: All major mapping services have fully adopted the new name globally.
options.B: The name change is visible on international versions of Apple Maps and Google, but not on the Canadian version of Apple Maps.
options.C: MapQuest has become the primary service to display the name 'Lake America' to users.
options.D: The Canadian government has successfully forced tech companies to revert the name to Lake Ontario.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據第二段，Apple Maps 與 Google 已在國際版應用程式中將其標示為「Lake America」，但加拿大版的 Apple Maps 仍保留「Lake Ontario」的舊稱。選項 A 錯誤，因為加拿大版並未更改；選項 C 錯誤，因為文章提到 MapQuest 選擇不跟進這些名稱變更；選項 D 錯誤，文章僅提到加拿大官員拒絕此變更，並未提到他們成功強制科技公司改回名稱。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the relationship between the trade conflict and the geographic naming dispute?

options.A: The renaming of the lake was the primary cause of the collapse of trade talks.
options.B: The naming dispute is an isolated incident that has no connection to the trade tensions.
options.C: The naming dispute serves as a symbolic extension of the broader political friction between the two nations.
options.D: The US government is using the naming dispute as a formal legal strategy to win trade negotiations.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章將地理名稱爭議描述為「Amid this growing conflict」（在日益增長的衝突中），暗示這不僅是單一事件，而是兩國緊張關係的延伸。選項 A 錯誤，因為貿易談判破裂的原因在第四、五段有明確指出（如語言權利、稅務爭議）；選項 B 錯誤，因為文章將其置於貿易衝突的背景下討論；選項 D 錯誤，文中並未將命名爭議描述為談判策略，僅視為一種行政命令。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the word 'vocal' mean as used in the sentence: 'President Trump has also been vocal about his position'?

options.B: Using a loud, physical tone of voice during speeches.
options.C: Singing or performing in a musical manner.
options.D: Changing his mind frequently regarding his policies.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此語境下，「vocal」意指「直言不諱的」或「強烈表達意見的」，指川普總統持續且公開地表達他對加拿大關稅政策的不滿。選項 B 是對該詞的字面誤解，並非指音量大小；選項 C 與音樂無關；選項 D 雖然川普立場強硬，但「vocal」本身並不代表立場反覆，而是強調表達的強度與頻率。

quiz.question: Which of the following best summarizes the central message of the article?

options.A: The primary focus of the article is the technical challenge of updating digital maps.
options.B: The article details the specific legal arguments used by Canada to defend its trade policies.
options.C: The article highlights the growing economic and political tensions between the US and Canada.
options.D: The article argues that trade wars are beneficial for the long-term economic growth of both nations.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。全文的核心在於探討美加兩國在貿易談判破裂後的緊張關係，並舉出關稅與地理命名爭議作為例證。選項 A 僅是文章的一部分，非主旨；選項 B 僅提到加拿大觀點，忽略了美國的立場與整體衝突；選項 D 錯誤，文章並未主張貿易戰是有益的，反而提到這會對兩國居民造成壓力，且未來充滿不確定性。
